_comment: Template for `create-clients-cosmos --l2-config` on AVALANCHE (C-Chain). Copy to
avalanche-client-config.json (gitignored) and fill in your deployment's values.
(--l2-config is the shared client-creation flag; Avalanche is an L1, it
just reuses the same attested-header client machinery as the rollups.)
The values below are FUJI (chain id 43113), so they are real and checkable. For
the local devnet (tmpnet) use l2_chain_id 43112 and the router address your
deploy printed. Its checked-in public key matches the local attestor handoff;
replace it with your own attestor public key on every other network.
rollup_profile is submitted verbatim in MsgCreateClient and the Rust verifier
rejects unknown fields, so common carries exactly these five keys.
Four fields must be right or the client fails, each in its own way:
profile_version  must be avalanche_attestor_v1 (the cw-ics08-wasm-avalanche
artifact) - a mismatch fails at instantiate with
InvalidProfileVersion.
l2_header_fork   must be coreth: C-Chain headers carry ext_data_hash plus
coreth's optional tail (Granite/Helicon fields), and the
client recomputes the block hash from exactly that layout.
A mismatch is rejected on EVERY update, not at creation.
l2_chain_id      must be the chain the relayer's l2_rpc_url actually serves
(43114 mainnet / 43113 Fuji / 43112 local tmpnet).
l2_router        the ICS26Router this deploy created on the C-Chain.
wasm_checksum is printed by scripts/local/wasm_avax.sh, and is the sha256 of the
UNCOMPRESSED wasm. counterparty_client_id is the client id on the C-Chain router
that tracks Cosmos; create-clients-eth registers the SpectreClient under it.
wasm_checksum: <hex checksum from `gaiad q ibc-wasm checksums`, e.g. a49e97b0...>
